title: nan
authors: Jing Y.; Sipahi R.; Martinez-Lorenzo J.
key_contribution: Presents Hybrid-RIO, a radar-inertial odometry system fusing four-directional FMCW mmWave radars with IMU for robust UAV positioning and autonomous navigation in GPS-denied low-light indoor environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
